usage: The word 錶 (biu1) refers to various types of meters used to measure quantities like electricity, water, or gas.
It is commonly used in household and utility contexts to refer to devices that record consumption.
Usually, 錶 is followed by a measure word or specific type such as 電錶 (electric meter) or 水錶 (water meter).
In conversation, 錶 often appears when discussing utility bills or checking usage.
This word is distinct from 手錶 (watch), though both contain 錶, the meaning depends on context.
